name: Science Collectibles Only Count When Complete
description: **Needs no other patch.** Makes tech points come slower, so the game is harder; off by default. In the base game every piece of the Lab Equipment collection (12 pieces) you find makes research bring more tech points: each successful research adds a random 0 to (pieces found - 1) more. With this patch those pieces add nothing until the collection is complete: with all 12 found, research gets the normal bonus (0 to 11 more). The researcher's own points, the Purify Tree's glow, the fire's extra point, the tech points a duplicate piece pays and everything else the collection does are unchanged.
behavior_changes: The research bonus (0x464E5D..0x464E82): the Lab Equipment count 0x413B90(0x52) is followed by cmp al,12 / jne (stock test eax,eax / jle), so fewer than 12 pieces add nothing and 12 add the stock rand(12), 0 to 11.
explicit_non_changes: The researcher's points, the Purify Tree's glow, the fire's +1, catch-up's research, the duplicates' tech points, the population room and the collections screens are unchanged.
One guarded in-place edit of 4 bytes; no code is added and no executable space is claimed.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; the bonus for every piece count is emulated stock and patched in tests/test_science_collectibles_complete.py; runtime/player confirmation pending

patches.purpose: the research bonus after the Lab Equipment count (0x464E6F): skip it unless all 12 pieces are found (stock: skip only with none)
